answer: Require every identity to post a refundable bond in a shared vault that is slashed if juries catch copied or incoherent work. A real agent pays this once and earns it back over time, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake and still generate fresh reasoning for each one. That steady cost is the signal: an honest participant is cheap to run, while a tide of fakes becomes more expensive than any payout it could drain.
